notes:
{愛|あい} refers to deep, enduring love, often with a literary or elevated feel compared to everyday expressions like ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧.

COMPARISON:
- {愛|あい}: profound love (literary, philosophical)
- ⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧: romantic love, passion, infatuation
- ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧: like, love (casual, everyday)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{愛|あい}している→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧: I love you (strong declaration)
- {愛|あい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧: with love
- ⟦{愛|あい}する→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: beloved person, loved one

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧: affection, love
- ⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧: romantic love, romance
- ⟦{愛着|あいちゃく}→愛着：04858_aichaku⟧: attachment, fondness
- ⟦{母性愛|ぼせいあい}→母性愛：28007_boseiai⟧: maternal love

USAGE NOTE:
⟦{愛|あい}している→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧ is a serious, committed expression of love. In everyday conversation, ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ or ⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧ is more common for expressing affection.
